description: Réseaux d'Assainissement Eaux usées (EU issu de la BDD RAEPA ) - Guyane (2018) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.geoguyane.fr. The database “Remediation Networks” (from RAEPA) collects the geolocated information necessary and sufficient for the minimum inventory of support networks of public sanitation services, for the moment only in operation, or built. As of that date, the projects are not included. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater Remediation Networks (EU from the RAEPA BDD) – Guyana (2018)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2020-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
